## About
We want to be the auto maintenance and repair facility for all your automotive needs. Our mechanics are highly skilled, have years of experience, and most of all, they love cars and care about yours.
For most people, auto maintenance and repair is not fun or convenient, so we want to make the process as easy and enjoyable as possible for you. Our first-time customers continually become our long term customers. We may not be related, but you'll feel like we're family.
Customers rate us 4.8 on Google from 75 reviews. One reviewer thanked Mike and staff, and another wrote that Dave runs the shop with Kat at the front desk.

## Services
- Check engine light: Check engine light on? Bring it in. One reviewer said we were very accommodating when hers came on.
- Diagnostics: One reviewer said Dave used state of the art diagnostics on her Chevy Spark.
- Inspection: Bring your car in for an inspection and see what our commitment to quality is all about.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. We're open Saturday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

Q: Can I call for a quote?
A: Yes. One customer called for a quote, then scheduled and checked on her car's status by phone, and said everyone in the office was extremely pleasant.

Q: Will I hear what needs fixing before the work is done?
A: One reviewer said that soon after dropping off his car he got an update on what needed to be replaced and the cost, and it was ready a couple of hours after he confirmed.
